cur-fossil-devils-lair.dateNote: Ernest Lundelius first dug this limestone cave near Margaret River, Western Australia, for fossils in 1955. Later digs found stone tools, hearths and bone beads: people used the cave from about 47,000 years ago (0.047 million years), among the oldest signs of people in Australia.
cur-fossil-devils-lair.summary: A cave in Western Australia used by people from about 47,000 years ago.
